gauge_inventory.regional_CGI: First-order gauge invariant relative to each exact FLRW background after the regional dust observer is fixed.
gauge_inventory.metric_crosscheck: HEURISTIC_METRIC_CROSS_CHECK: Listing six raw scalar functions and informally subtracting two scalar coordinate-gauge directions and two scalar Einstein constraints is only a consistency illustration. It is not an independent state-count proof or a phase-space-rank proof: configuration-space and phase-space variables may otherwise be mixed; the Einstein equations and constraints need not be algebraically independent in an unspecified formulation; constraint propagation is a separate requirement; and gauge generators, gauge conditions, and canonical variables must be counted in a fully specified formulation. The exact two-state, rank-two regional result follows solely from the independently derived CGI propagation system, not from this arithmetic.

H-D0.assumptions: The words domain, boundary and zero volume measure are read literally and no unprinted hypersurface structure is inferred.
H-D0.derivation_summary: GM defines a third zero-measure boundary domain for formal single-spacetime wall/void matching and immediately says it remains unspecified.
H-D0.implementation_consequence: No Darmois, shell or boundary evolution can be implemented from this statement.
H-D0.observational_consequence: No finite-infinity or survey boundary identification follows.
H-D0.evidence_needed_to_change_status: A primary Timescape construction specifying dimension, embeddings, causal type, normal, induced geometry and transport.

H-D1.assumptions: Exact spherical FLRW regions, timelike interface comoving on both sides, constant gamma-law perfect fluids and Friedmann evolution.
H-D1.derivation_summary: Comoving induced geometry makes the scale factors proportional by a constant; Kirchner proves equal Hubble histories identify the gamma-law FLRW model, so distinct regions are impossible under these assumptions.
H-D1.coordinate_dependencies: Comoving radial coordinates on both FLRW sides.
H-D1.frame_dependencies: FLRW perfect-fluid rest frames and junction proper time.
H-D1.implementation_consequence: The literal distinct comoving exact-FLRW junction branch is rejected; no universal junction no-go is asserted.
H-D1.observational_consequence: None; the theorem does not select finite infinity or an observational interface.
H-D1.evidence_needed_to_change_status: A flaw in the primary derivation or a branch outside the explicitly stated assumptions.

H-D2.source: GM p. 22; B00; BMR20; MMV07; KIR03; W09
H-D2.assumptions: Prefer the route adding the least structure beyond current domain and averaging objects.
H-D2.derivation_summary: C-AVG avoids assigning codimension, causal type or surface stress to the unspecified GM domain; C-JUNC, C-SHELL, C-TRANS and C-FI each add branch-specific structure.
H-D2.coordinate_dependencies: C-AVG still needs a future common carrier and clock maps.
H-D2.frame_dependencies: Comoving regional partition and dust averaging foliation.
H-D2.implementation_consequence: Retain C-AVG for design, but do not treat it as closed.
H-D2.observational_consequence: No radial-null, finite-infinity or tracer bridge is created.
H-D2.evidence_needed_to_change_status: A primary source showing that another branch is already defined by current Timescape machinery or that C-AVG is inconsistent.

H-D3.assumptions: One exact irrotational dust FLRW region, dust-comoving geodesic frame, scalar k nonzero sector, first order.
H-D3.derivation_summary: Setting w=P=V=F=0 yields dot Delta_r=-Z_r and dot Z_r=-2H_r Z_r-4 pi G rho_r Delta_r; the pair is equivalent to the second-order dust growth equation.
H-D3.coordinate_dependencies: Regional proper time tau_r and regional spatial Laplacian normalization.
H-D3.implementation_consequence: Regional intrinsic bulk has two state functions and rank two per region. This exact result comes from the CGI equations; HEURISTIC_METRIC_CROSS_CHECK is not an independent proof.
H-D3.observational_consequence: These are regional CGI density/expansion variables, not tracer velocity or f sigma_8.
H-D3.evidence_needed_to_change_status: A primary-source constraint showing an additional independent scalar mode under the same assumptions.

H-D4.assumptions: CGI scalars are spatial Laplacians and the elliptic kernel is treated explicitly.
H-D4.derivation_summary: Homogeneous scalar fields are annihilated by the Laplacian; background-parameter tangents therefore form a separate R-0 branch.
H-D4.coordinate_dependencies: Depends on regional Laplace-Beltrami operator and topology.
H-D4.implementation_consequence: A Green inverse must project out its full kernel; R-INH cannot silently vary K_r, f_v0 or normalizations.
H-D4.observational_consequence: No code or survey wavenumber identification follows.
H-D4.evidence_needed_to_change_status: A different declared variable definition that includes the homogeneous sector.

H-D5.source: Definitions f_v=V_v/(V_v+V_w), Xi_r=dot V_r/V_r; BMR20 and MH24 for clock/foliation distinctions
H-D5.assumptions: Two comoving subdomain volumes are differentiated with one common time.
H-D5.derivation_summary: Exact differentiation gives dot f_v=f_v f_w(Xi_v-Xi_w); linearization and L_D application produce an expansion-transfer source and an operator commutator.
H-D5.coordinate_dependencies: Common-time derivative and carrier Laplacian transport.
H-D5.frame_dependencies: Common averaging foliation; Xi_r is not set equal to Theta_r without proof.
H-D5.implementation_consequence: The fifth state equation is not closed until clock/expansion transfer and commutator behavior are specified.
H-D5.observational_consequence: None; this is partition transport, not a peculiar velocity.
